method: CUA native macOS Electron, real App and components; isolated mock DesktopBridge, no provider request

observed.button: Click updates counter; Tab reaches accent action with visible ring
observed.checkbox: Space toggles 1 to 0; disabled controls remain disabled
observed.select: Search B filters to B while value remains A; Escape returns focus to trigger A
observed.disclosure: Space closes; Enter reopens; textarea remains preserved draft
observed.modal: Escape closes and focus returns to open trigger
observed.tooltip: Keyboard Tab reveals descriptive text; Escape dismisses
observed.themes: light and dark observed; narrow control wrapping observed

not_run: physical drag resize; narrow window launched at fixed 720 width
capture_notes: Native OS window sharing pill is system chrome. dark-narrow-controls is a closed-state control composition, not an open select. Initial light/dark-forms captures predate final demo width adjustment; final narrow-forms captures show the adjusted grid.
